_README: Club facts shown in the site footer. Everything here is optional: each block
renders only when it is filled in, so leaving a value as null is safe and the
footer simply omits that line. Nothing here should be a guess — this file is
the reason the site can say 'we meet on Tuesdays' without anyone inventing it.
contact  — how a newcomer reaches the club. label is what the link says,
url is where it goes (a Discord invite, a mailto:, a form).
meetings — one line describing when and where the club meets, e.g.
